questions.q: The correct order of speed of movement of alkali metal ions in aqueous solution is

The alkali metal ions exist as hydrated ions, MH2Ox+, in the aqueous solution. The degree of hydration, however, decreases with the increasing ionic size as we move from Li+ to Cs+. In other words, Li+ ion is the most hydrated. e.g. LiH2O6+.

Since the mobility of ion is inversely proportional to the size of their hydrated ions, therefore, amongst the alkali metal ions, lithium has the lowest ionic mobility.
